title: Grid That Fits Itself
prompt:
Replace fixed column counts with the responsive one-liner: `.gallery` uses `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))` — as many 180px-minimum columns as fit, each sharing space equally.

Rules:
- Keep `display: grid` and `gap: 1rem`.
- Swap the template to the auto-fit form.

tests.name: auto-fit with a 180px minimum
tests.hint: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)) — columns appear only when they fit.

tests.name: grid and gap survive
tests.code:
if (!/\.gallery\s*\{[^}]*display\s*:\s*grid\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Keep display: grid.");
if (!/\.gallery\s*\{[^}]*gap\s*:\s*1rem\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Keep gap: 1rem.");

tests.name: no media query needed
tests.hint: The whole point of auto-fit: responsiveness without media queries.
